original_text:
Statement Regarding Treasury Securities Small Value Exercise

October 30, 2026
The New York Fed undertakes certain small value open market transactions for the purpose of testing operational readiness to implement existing and potential policy directives from the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC). The FOMC authorizes and directs the New York Fed's Open Market Trading Desk (the Desk) to conduct these exercises to test its operational readiness in the FOMC Authorizations and Continuing Directives for Open Market Operations.
In connection with these directives, the Desk intends to conduct a small value Treasury sale operation on Tuesday, November 3, 2026, beginning around 9:00AM ET and ending at 9:20AM ET. The sale will not exceed a face value of $50 million and will be limited to Treasury nominal coupon securities maturing between 1.5 and 3 years from the date of the operation.
Results will be posted on the New York Fed's website following the completion of the operation. The results will include the securities and total amounts accepted and submitted.
translation_ja:
国債の小額演習についての声明。2026年10月30日。

NY連銀は、FOMCの現行および潜在的な政策指令を実施する運営準備を試すため、一部の小額公開市場取引を行う。FOMCは公開市場操作に関する承認・継続指令において、公開市場デスクにこれらの演習を承認・指示している。

この指令に基づき、デスクは2026年11月3日火曜日、米東部時間9:00頃から9:20まで、小額の国債売却オペを行う予定。額面上限は5,000万ドルで、対象はオペ日から残存1.5～3年の名目利付国債に限る。

結果はオペ完了後にNY連銀サイトへ掲載され、証券と落札額・応募額の合計を含む。
